create_obfuscated_names_generator: create an ObfuscatedNamesGenerator instance to generate obfuscated names for variables, functions, and classes
get_new_obfuscated_name: get a new obfuscated name for a variable, function, or class using get_new_name
get_obfuscation_dictionary: get the complete obfuscation dictionary mapping obfuscated names back to original names
check_function_obfuscated: check if a function name has already been obfuscated using function_is_obfuscated
obfuscate_attribute_names: obfuscate attribute names by passing isAttribute=True to get_new_name
